items.title: Arturo O'Farrill interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2024
items.q: this of course is your father’s arrangements on a Basie record

ctx.x: Ah, incredible. Of course I remember that.

And do you have a — this of course is your father’s arrangements on a Basie record. Do you have a memory of a certain age when you realized that your father was not in a normal day gig type job, that maybe his business was a little crazy?

I mean that presumes that I had an idea of what normality was. For me normality was Chico. I mean I remember being probably four or five and he had a TV show in Mexico and I remember going with him to a taping and just I think for some reasons a bicycle comes into that memory — whether they were giving me one or had one to give or I don’t know, but I just remember rehearsals and parties and conducting. I remember so many things that didn’t seem at all absurd to me. I didn’t think twice about having Dizzy…
